decl.text:
dbCreatePath(
d_cellView txl_layerPurposel_points
n_width
[ t_pathStyle ]
)
=> d_path / nil

description.text:
Creates a path.
Note: dbCreatePath is a core database SKILL function that checks only for even multiples of database units to create a path. As a result, the created path can be off grid. To create a path with required constraints and additional level of automation use an end-application SKILL function, such as leCreatePath.

items.name: txl_layerPurpose
items.desc:
Name, number, or a list of layer or layer-purpose pair.
For more information, see Type txl_layerPurpose.

items.name: t_purpose
items.desc: Purpose, if not specified, defaults to drawing.

items.name: l_points
items.desc:
Point list; must contain at least two points.
For more information, see Type l_point.

items.name: n_width
items.desc: Path width specified in user units.

items.name: t_pathStyle
items.desc:
Path style, defaults to truncateExtend.
For more information, see Type t_pathStyle.

arguments.text:
d_cellView
The cellview.
txl_layerPurpose
Name, number, or a list of layer or layer-purpose pair.
For more information, see Type txl_layerPurpose.
t_purpose
Purpose, if not specified, defaults to drawing.
l_points
Point list; must contain at least two points.
For more information, see Type l_point.
n_width
Path width specified in user units.
t_pathStyle
Path style, defaults to truncateExtend.
For more information, see Type t_pathStyle.

returns.text:
d_path
The dbObject of the path.
nil
The path is not created.

example.text:
dbCreatePath(cv 2 list(0:0 0:1 1:1 1:0) 4 "extendExtend")
dbCreatePath(cv list("background" "drawing") list(1:6 1:1 2:1) 2 )
dbCreatePath(cv list ("background") list(0:0 1:0 1:2 2:3) 2 "squareFlush")
Note: if you specify a list of points where more than two points have the same X coordinate or the same Y coordinate, a message is generated
Note: If you specify a list of points where more than two points have the same X coordinate or the same Y coordinate, a message is generated in the CIW. For example, the following code generates a warning message in the CIW:
dbCreatePath(cv list("metal3" "drawing") '((2 2) (2 4) (2 6)) 2)
